name: CWRU held-out fault-class benchmark, T2 class partition
normalization: subtract each window mean; divide by each window standard deviation, floor 1e-6; no dataset-level fitting
image_conversion: Lossless row-major reshape of the same normalized 1024 samples into 32x32; not STFT or scalogram
backbone: 4 blocks: Conv(64,k=3,pad=1), GroupNorm(8,64), ReLU, MaxPool(2); adaptive pooling to 256 features; 1D/2D operation variants
maml: Full second-order MAML, 4-class linear head, 3 SGD inner steps at 0.05 during meta-training, Adam outer lr=0.001
reptile: 5 Adam source-support minibatch steps at 0.001 (betas 0,0.999), batch size 10; interpolate initialization, epsilon 1.0 to 0.1; target Adam uses all support
protonet: Class-mean support embeddings; negative mean squared Euclidean distance; cross-entropy episodic training
relationnet: Class-mean support feature map concatenated with query map; two 64-channel Conv/GN/ReLU/pool blocks; global average pooling; FC64-8-1 with LeakyReLU(0.1); cross-entropy across four relation logits
checkpoint_selection: highest source-validation 4-way 5-shot accuracy; target not used
adaptation_selection: mean source-validation accuracy across 1,5,10 shots, 10 shared episodes per shot
paired_evaluation: same episode class order, same query indices, and nested first-K support indices for every model/backbone/seed/shot
aggregation: mean episode accuracy within each training seed; report mean and sample SD across 3 independent training seeds
limitations: Same recording provides temporally separated support and query pools within each target class; this is not independent-bearing generalization. New implementation/protocol, not a reproduction of MetaFD numbers. Algorithm training budgets differ in gradient work although source tasks and 1200 episodes are shared.
source_validation_revision: Initial SGD Reptile was weak on source validation; initial RelationNet MLP/MSE collapsed at source chance. Before target evaluation of this revision, switch Reptile to Adam minibatches and RelationNet to a convolutional relation head with cross-entropy. MAML and ProtoNet retain their unchanged original runs.
